integrity.arithmetical_method: exact integer prime-local Smith reductions with two independent deleted vertices, plus an analytic graph-spectrum argument

scientific_limitations: The stable marked-incidence curve is constructed by gluing components, and is not claimed to be the minimal resolution or total nodal transform of the original line arrangement.
Identification with geometric Néron components requires a proper regular split semistable smoothing with node thickness one.
The critical groups cover the cyclic and dihedral group tables of order six, not every order-six Latin square.
Historical priority is provisional; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Cospectral order-six plane-net boundaries with different integral Néron groups
